scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in bun/*) ;; *) echo "Use bun instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --filter '@workspace/gateway-console' build
scripts.coverage: bun run --filter '@workspace/gateway-console' coverage && bun run --filter '@workspace/api-client-react' coverage
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/console/src apps/console/index.html apps/console/package.json apps/console/vite.config.ts apps/console/vitest.config.ts lib/api-client-react/src/custom-fetch.ts lib/api-client-react/src/index.ts lib/api-client-react/test lib/api-client-react/package.json lib/api-client-react/vitest.config.ts lib/api-spec/orval.config.ts lib/api-spec/package.json lib/api-spec/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/console/src apps/console/index.html apps/console/package.json apps/console/vite.config.ts apps/console/vitest.config.ts lib/api-client-react/src/custom-fetch.ts lib/api-client-react/src/index.ts lib/api-client-react/test lib/api-client-react/package.json lib/api-client-react/vitest.config.ts lib/api-spec/orval.config.ts lib/api-spec/package.json lib/api-spec/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.lint: eslint apps/console/src apps/console/vite.config.ts apps/console/vitest.config.ts lib/api-client-react/src/custom-fetch.ts lib/api-client-react/test lib/api-client-react/vitest.config.ts lib/api-spec/orval.config.ts
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@workspace/gateway-console' test && bun run --filter '@workspace/api-client-react' test
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:libs && bun run --filter '@workspace/gateway-console' typecheck
